class.name: Box3DSurfaceMaterialLibrary
class.description: [Box3DSurfaceMaterialLibrary] is loaded from the [code]physics/box3d/surface_material_library[/code] project setting and indexed by [Box3DPhysics]. It contains 15 permanent numbered slots. A slot with an empty material name is unconfigured and does not appear in runtime queries or editor material pickers.

method.name: find_material
method.description: Returns the authored material named [param name], or [code]null[/code]. Unlike [method Box3DPhysics.get_material] this searches the raw array, so it also finds entries the registry rejected.

members.member: The 15 surface material slot resources in permanent numeric-id order. Array index [code]0[/code] is id [code]1[/code], through index [code]14[/code] as id [code]15[/code]. Empty names mark unconfigured slots. [method Box3DPhysics.get_materials] returns configured slots only. Legacy variable-length arrays are normalized by retaining valid ids and moving colliding or out-of-range entries into free slots. More than 15 configured entries is rejected without truncating the source array.
